The '''Magistrates of Benetage''' were a government organization operating on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Benetage/Legends|Benetage]] in the era preceding the rise of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Their symbol of office, the [[Crown of Verity/Legends|Crown of Verity]], was recovered by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] nearly thirty millennia after the Magistrates and all of Benetage's population disappeared mysteriously.
